class.name: JarBodyLayer
class.brief_description: Base class of things drawn around a JarCelestialBody.
class.description: Water, atmosphere and clouds: put them under a [JarCelestialBody] (any depth). They update every frame from the body's frame (center, up, sea level), in the editor too. Without a body they do nothing.

method.name: find_sun
method.description: The light used as the sun: [member sun], or the first [DirectionalLight3D] in the scene.

method.name: get_body
method.description: The body this layer belongs to: the nearest [JarCelestialBody] above.

members.member: The light used as the sun. Empty: the first [DirectionalLight3D] in the scene.
